name: opportunity_quote_age_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: OPPORTUNITY_QUOTE_AGE_20261104 — FQ-088 (HQ-04): Home's Best opportunities consumes the list as-of and each row's quote observation. A quote older than 30 minutes, in the future, missing or unreadable is never presented as current; the caption and sentence say the age and session, and an absent list as-of renders nothing rather than a stamp. Pytest-collectable so the shard runner executes it (a .mjs file cannot be collected); the gate test RUNS apps/command-center-v3/src/lib/opportunityQuoteAge.test.mjs with node rather than mirroring it.
